associationLimits: Request and START counters are independent; each is matched through the accepted request chain.
START omits variant and candidate omits startSeq/variant; every available identity field is cross-checked.
Damage has no requestSeq or child-owner field: ordered window, role and READY actor identity determine bounded attribution; reused addresses outside the window are excluded.
Enemy entry HP is not logged at REQ. For hit previews it is derived from the first damage event, then all intermediate steps and final READY HP are checked.
Weapons150 and151 have no observed damage, READY enemyHP6000 and normal closure. This does not prove effective attacks, successful initialization, or combat utility.
Every gameplay/combat event in the selected windows is retained with exact source byte positions; unrelated IO/HID events and automatic-repeat windows are excluded.
The seven prefix system exceptions and startup request-null observer gap are outside these windows and retained independently; a whole-session zero-exception claim is not made.
Unknown-cause request87/88/89 transitions and later request89 object snapshots are outside this selected batch. No manual-UI or automatic cause is inferred from superseded events.
Menu previews do not establish training, combo, interruption, reload, level progression or all153 acceptance.
